prompt_md: You cut a square tile whose side is a uniformly random length between 0 and 10 cm. On average, what is the tile's area, in square cm?
prompt_short: Square with a random side from 0 to 10 cm. Average area?
hint_md: Squaring rewards big sides more than it punishes small ones.
explain_intuition_md: The average side is 5 cm, and a 5 cm square has area 25. But squaring rewards big sides more than it punishes small ones: a 9 cm tile has area 81, a 1 cm tile only 1. So the average area beats the area of the average side.
